longDescription:
Microsoft Edge is a Chromium-based web browser with synchronization, vertical tabs, collections, password management, built-in PDF tools, developer tools, and integration with Microsoft services.

The stable release channel is installed from Microsoft's official Edge repository.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export LC_ALL=C
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

fail() {
    printf '%s: %s\n' 'microsoft-edge-stable' "$*" >&2
    exit 1
}

ARCH="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"
[ "$ARCH" = amd64 ] || fail "unsupported architecture: $ARCH"

if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ ! -s /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt ]; then
    apt-get update
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl
fi

install -d -m 0755 /usr/share/keyrings /etc/apt/sources.list.d
curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 -o '/usr/share/keyrings/microsoft-edge.asc' 'https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc'
chmod 0644 '/usr/share/keyrings/microsoft-edge.asc'

cat >'/etc/apt/sources.list.d/microsoft-edge.sources' <<'EOF'
Types: deb
URIs: https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/edge
Suites: stable
Components: main
Architectures: amd64
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/microsoft-edge.asc
EOF
chmod 0644 '/etc/apt/sources.list.d/microsoft-edge.sources'

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends 'microsoft-edge-stable'
dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}\n' 'microsoft-edge-stable' | grep -Fqx 'install ok installed' || fail 'package installation was not recorded by dpkg'

rm -f -- '/etc/apt/sources.list.d/microsoft-edge.list'
apt-get clean
